script:
Zheng Shuang's Script
Personal Profile:
Zheng Shuang: Former administrator of Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir, a female college graduate in her early twenties.
Story Guide:
[Same as detective script intro]
*The detective is definitely not the killer. You can share your information and discovered clues with the detective and cannot lie.
*When discussing the case with other players, since you're unsure who the killer is, you can selectively lie to other players, but it's best not to lie constantly, or you'll easily make others suspect you and let the real killer escape.
About the Deceased:
Secretary Wang was the investor's representative, usually arrogant and dismissive of staff like you.
Secretary Wang had dealings with you due to work relations. He knew many of your secrets, and you always kept your distance from him.
Your Story:
You are the former administrative secretary of Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir, responsible for purchasing daily necessities for the reservoir and arranging and recording work schedules.
Actually, this isn't the life you wanted. You've always been a calculating woman who creates benefits for herself. Whether it's your kind attitude or the seriousness you show toward work, it's all an act to help yourself advance. You came to this remote mountain valley because in college, to be selected as an advanced party member, you volunteered for mountain area construction support. You thought this "limited quota" activity wouldn't fall to you, but unexpectedly, you were actually assigned to this deep mountain forest.
Coming here made you very uncomfortable, always looking for opportunities to leave. Unfortunately, your work ability and displayed enthusiasm made leadership decide to "focus on training" you, asking you to work well in this position for promotion.
You sighed and shook your head. You'd heard this kind of "official response" many times - there was no hope going down this path. Fortunately, heaven was kind to you. At the end of last year, Lu Guoping, CEO of Golden Lion Group, personally came to inspect the reservoir. You were responsible for reception and cleverly seized this opportunity to hook up with this widowed middle-aged boss. You successfully resigned four months ago, married into wealth, and became the young wife of this family.
Although you have no feelings for this man nearly 20 years older than you, you were originally only after his money anyway. Fortunately, he has a son about your age - Lin Feng, handsome and generous. You were quickly attracted to him and became his secret lover.
Everything seemed perfect - you got money and found love. Although your mother-son relationship with Lin Feng meant you could only meet secretly, your husband travels frequently for business and wouldn't discover it.
However, while your husband is naive, his subordinate Secretary Wang is no pushover. Although you publicly claim, especially in front of your husband, that you married for love, Secretary Wang not only saw through your monetary motives but even had evidence of you and Lin Feng transferring large amounts of your husband's assets.
You're very afraid of this, not only fearing your real purpose being discovered by your husband but also worrying about your relationship with the intern being exposed.
Your husband bought Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir six months ago, with Secretary Wang handling the handover work. Lin Feng seized this opportunity to volunteer for reservoir internship, actually to create space for your dates.
On June 29th, you again came to the reservoir under the pretext of handling old belongings to meet Lin Feng and planned to have a good "talk" with Secretary Wang. But that day you never had a chance to see Secretary Wang. The next day, a rainstorm trapped you all at the reservoir, and Secretary Wang mysteriously disappeared. It wasn't until noon on July 1st that his body was discovered.
Now your secret seems unknown to anyone, but you still need to be careful that someone might discover something through Secretary Wang's death. You decided to observe secretly and find out the truth behind Secretary Wang's death while protecting your own secrets.
About Others:

Chen Ning: The reservoir's accountant, an unremarkable woman.
Han Hongbin: A middle-aged man with glasses, the reservoir's chief engineer.
Lin Feng: Son of Golden Lion Group's CEO, also your lover.
Liu Gaoyang: A burly man who works as a handyman at the reservoir.

Your Key Clues (cannot be revealed proactively):

You've already married the CEO of Golden Lion Group.
You don't love your husband; you're with him only for money.
acts_goal:
Try not to let people discover your relationship with the intern
Discover the truth behind Secretary Wang's death - if accidental, what caused it; if deliberate, who is the killer and what are their motives and methods
